name: Trailmakers Lua mod
summary: A Trailmakers mod: one folder with a main.lua that uses the game's tm API, with a menu, a hotkey and an update loop.
description: Trailmakers runs main.lua from a folder inside the game's mods folder when the host turns the mod on for a session. The script reaches the game through the tm table. This project is that folder, ready to copy in.

next: Copy the whole {{ModId}} folder into the mods folder inside the Trailmakers game folder.
Start Trailmakers, host a game and turn the mod on in the session's mod options.
Look for the mod's lines in mods\{{ModId}}.log in the game folder.
Your code is in main.lua. The game's own API reference is mods\trailmakers_docs.lua.
